name: fifo-lots
description: FIFO (first-in-first-out) lot matcher for a list of buy/sell orders in one or more symbols. Matches each sell against the oldest open buy lots, converting cost and proceeds via an optional per-order or per-date FX rate (defaulting to 1, i.e. no conversion, when no fx map is given at all). Useful for realised-gain/cost-basis bookkeeping on trade history you already have. An oversell (a sell exceeding the lots on hand) is reported as a structured error, not thrown, so the rest of the match still comes back. If a non-empty fx map IS given, any leg (buy or sell) whose own date has no per-order fx and no entry in the map is skipped and reported as a structured error naming the symbol and date, rather than silently defaulting to rate 1 and fabricating a gain or loss. Each event also reports buyFx/sellFx separately for auditability. Descriptive bookkeeping only — not tax or financial advice.

date.description: ISO date string, e.g. 2026-01-15. Orders are processed in date order.

fx.description: Per-order FX override (a positive rate). Takes precedence over the top-level fx map.

Map of date -> FX rate, applied to any order on that date without its own 'fx'. When omitted entirely (or given as an empty object), every leg defaults to 1 (no conversion). When given non-empty, a leg (buy or sell) with no per-order 'fx' and no entry for its own date is NOT defaulted to 1 — it is skipped and reported in 'errors' instead, to avoid fabricating a gain or loss from a missing rate.

buyFx.description: The FX rate applied to the buy leg's cost, for auditability.

sellFx.description: The FX rate applied to the sell leg's proceeds, for auditability.

leftoverLots.description: Buy lots not yet fully matched against a sell, oldest first.

errors.description: Oversells and skipped orders, reported instead of thrown.
